run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with a given calculator
compute_adsorption_energy_hybrid: compute the hybrid adsorption energy using DFT slab energies and ML-relaxed adslab energies
compute_adsorption_energy_full: compute the full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with an ML calculator
compute_adsorption_energy_direct: compute the direct adsorption energy from the relaxed adslab potential energy and DFT reference values
save_relaxed_atoms_json: save relaxed adslab and slab atoms as JSON-encoded objects in the adsorption results dictionary
